# sample-skill

## Purpose

Sample skill used by the Manta Phase 7a fixture to test the validator's
manifest-vs-disk cross-check logic. Not used by any real clone code.

## Allowed

- Anything inside the fixture's allowed scope.

## Forbidden

- Anything outside the fixture's allowed scope.

## Examples

A good use of this fixture: load it into a library package staging dir
and run `validatePackage` against it.
